name: Chokes and choke manifolds
description: Choke valves and choke manifolds provide well isolation, flow routing and flow control on trees and manifolds. A choke is described as the smallest restriction in a Christmas tree, used to control production rate (and in some cases sand production), with two types: positive chokes with interchangeable beans and adjustable chokes.
